description: OKLAHOMA CITY — Tax-Free Weekend is almost here in Oklahoma, but one item parents are about to head to the store to get isn’t covered: school supplies. Oklahoma’s Tax-Free Weekend, which is Aug. 1-3, only covers clothing or footwear under $100. School supplies, clothes and footwear meant for “athletic activity or protective use” aren’t covered […]
title: Oklahoma lawmaker starts push to include school supplies in Tax-Free Weekend - Kristen for Oklahoma
